acquisition method: LC-SRM measurements of Tau L/H peptide ratios were performed; operated in positive DDA top 20 mode
alkylation reagent: 1% acrylamide for cysteine alkylation; alkylated with 100 μL 0.05 M iodoacetamide solution
cleavage agent: digested with 12.5 μg/ml trypsin; underwent GluC and AspN digestion
enrichment method: purified from lysate cleared of large particles and aggregates of 4 separate AD patients using MC-1 antibody immunoaffinity columns
fractionation method: sarkosyl fractionation was performed; fractionated by size-exclusion chromatography
instrument: Q Exactive; 5500 QTRAP; Q Exactive HF
quadrupole Orbitrap tandem mass spectrometer (Q Exactive, Thermo Fisher Scientific); triple quadrupole mass spectrometer (5500 QTRAP, Sciex); Q Exactive HF
labeling: Label-free quantification was done using the XIC-based in-built label-free quantification (LFQ) algorithm integrated into MaxQuant
precursor tolerance: allowed initial precursor mass deviation up to 7 ppm
fragment tolerance: allowed fragment mass deviation of 20 ppm
ptm: variable: Oxidation of M; acetylation of N-termini; phosphorylation of S, T, Y; acetylation of K; ubiquitination (GlyGly); static: propionylation of cysteine

Oxidation of M, acetylation of N-termini, phosphorylation of S, T, Y, acetylation of K, and ubiquitination (GlyGly) were chosen as variable modifications and propionylation of cysteine as static modification
reduction reagent: DTT as reduction agent; reduced by adding 400 μL 8 M urea supplemented with 200 mM tris (2-carboxyethyl) phosphine (TCEP)
